item.title: S&P 500 futures slide ahead of more economic data as tech shares fall for a second day: Live updates
item.description: Nasdaq-100 futures fell sharply Thursday as concerns around tech companies overspending on artificial intelligence grew.

item.title: U.S. reportedly considers use of 'mother of all bombs' as Iran vows to fight on
item.description: The U.S. military has reportedly drawn up options for strikes on Iran that include the potential use of one of the biggest non-nuclear bombs in its arsenal.

item.title: Memory stocks are getting hammered. China and a 2029 oversupply are the big worries
item.description: SK Hynix, Samsung and Micron have been some of the hardest-hit names in the latest tech sell-off.

item.title: Cboe to expand options trading hours for major stocks and ETFs
item.description: Cboe will offer trading on 24 of the most actively traded companies and five ETFs between 7:30 a.m. and 9:25 a.m. ET and 4:00 p.m. to 4:15 p.m. ET.
